people.name: Ganesh Divekar
people.bio:
I am Ganesh Divekar, currently leading AI/ML initiatives at Bajaj Technology Services. With over 10 years of experience, I bring a unique blend of expertise across AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Science, Cloud, Databases, Frontend, Backend, and Enterprise Architecture.

My technical journey spans:
AI/ML & Data Science – Predictive analytics, NLP-driven automation, recommender systems, time-series forecasting, deep learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and advanced LLM ecosystems (GPT-4, GPT-4o, Mistral, Llama, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP).
RAG & Knowledge Systems – FAISS, Qdrant, Pinecone, Azure AI Search, LlamaIndex.
Cloud Platforms – AWS, Azure, GCP with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and microservices architecture.
Databases & Data Engineering – DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Hive, Redis, Kafka, scalable pipelines.
Backend Engineering – Java, Kotlin, GoLang, Spring Boot, FastAPI, Node.js with clean architecture principles.
Frontend Engineering – React, Flutter, Next.js, building cross-platform applications with strong UX focus.
Security & Compliance – Nginx, TLS 1.3, IAM/RBAC, AES-GCM encryption, enterprise-grade InfoSec guardrails.
I’ve implemented real-time predictive analytics, AI-powered chatbots, voice AI assistants, financial advisory systems, KYC/document verification platforms, and workflow automation solutions that have transformed enterprise operations and customer experiences.
Beyond my professional work, I am an active speaker, mentor, and community contributor, sharing insights on AI, Data Science, and Full-Stack Innovation at global conferences, developer communities, and universities. My passion is to harness AI and engineering for transformative automation, performance optimization, and intelligent user interactions.

people.name: Himanshu Jain
people.bio:

With more than 18 years of experience across AI & Automation, Cloud, and Software Engineering, he has established Global Capability Centers in India and Colombia, set up AI Centers of Excellence, and scaled engineering operations for global impact.

At Academian, Himanshu drives the company’s AI Accelerator Platform leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, and multi-component orchestration to build intelligent and scalable EdTech solutions. He leads strategic initiatives including AWS partnership programs, pre-sales solutioning, and AI product innovation.

Previously, he held senior leadership roles at Salient Process India Private Limited, Tata Elxsi Limited, and Infosys Technologies Limited. A frequent speaker and jury member at national tech events, Himanshu is passionate about shaping the future of enterprise AI.

people.name: Drijesh Ppatel
people.bio:
Meet Drijesh PPatel, a dynamic figure in the world of technology, renowned for his adept leadership and unwavering commitment to innovation. 

From his early days as a Technical Lead to his current role as an Engineering Manager at IBM, Drijesh has consistently demonstrated his prowess across various domains, with a particular focus on AI, Agile Project Management, Cloud Technologies, and Cyber Security. His career boasts a plethora of achievements, including spearheading groundbreaking initiatives within the BFSI, Healthcare, and Insurance sectors, earning him accolades such as being named among the "40 under 40", "20 Influential Personalities of India", "100 Future Leaders", and "Rising Tech-Expert 2024" to name a few.

Drijesh's leadership extends beyond the confines of the corporate world; he is also an avid photographer and a dedicated mentor, embodying a holistic approach to life. He has been a speaker at more than 300 events and mentored 700+ individuals to attain their desirable goals. With a relentless drive for excellence and a passion for fostering growth, Drijesh PPatel stands as a beacon of inspiration for aspiring leaders and technology enthusiasts alike.

people.name: Soumya Upadhyay
people.bio:
For the past 15 years, I've worn many hats in the dynamic world of civil engineering. From the intricacies of the RMC industry to the broader landscape of building materials, I've gained invaluable experience that has shaped me into the entrepreneur I am today.

This journey hasn't just been about bricks and mortar. It's been about mastering business operating systems, ensuring quality control and assurance, fostering strategic business development, and building high-performing teams through training and motivation.

As a motivational speaker, I'm passionate about addressing the current challenges faced by young civil engineers and budding professionals. Sharing my experiences and insights with the next generation is incredibly rewarding. For this I have been awarded National Level DB Women Pride Award 2017.  🥇 

Having collaborated with renowned corporates, I've had the privilege of working on diverse projects and learning from industry leaders. These experiences have instilled in me a deep understanding of the industry and the drive to make a positive impact.

 Looking ahead, I'm excited to continue:

Innovating within the civil engineering space.
Mentoring future generations of engineers.
Collaborating with inspiring individuals and organizations.
If you're a civil engineer, entrepreneur, or simply interested in the construction industry, I'd love to connect!
